name: abap2go
description: Ahead-of-time compiler for ABAP, emitting Go

scripts.test: tsc && node --test --test-concurrency=4 "build/test/**/*.test.js" && cd runtime/go && go vet ./... && go test ./...
scripts.hello: tsc && node build/src/cli.js --input examples/hello --root ZHELLO --out out/hello
scripts.classrun: tsc && node build/src/cli.js --input examples/classrun --root ZCL_HELLO --out out/classrun
